text: 据新华社，中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平近日就发展先进制造业作出重要指示指出，党的十八大以来，我国先进制造业不断发展壮大，创新力、竞争力、综合实力显著增强，制造强国建设迈出坚实步伐。
text_en: According to Xinhua News Agency, Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the People's Republic of China, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, recently issued important instructions on developing advanced manufacturing, stating that since the 18th CPC National Congress, China's advanced manufacturing has continued to develop and grow, with innovation capability, competitiveness, and overall strength significantly enhanced, and solid strides made in building a manufacturing powerhouse.
